home_title.en: Terminal API Client for .http Files | go-rest-client
home_title.zh: 在終端機執行 API 測試｜go-rest-client

en.home: Terminal API client in Go by Pardn Chiu (邱敬幃): send requests from .http files in a TUI with hot reload on save and live SSE streaming.
en.getting-started: Install go-rest-client with go build or go install, send your first request from a .http file, and see where it fits among API clients.
en.http-file-format: How go-rest-client splits .http files into requests: ### separators, ### Name labels, request line regex, and comments.
en.http-file-format-headers-body: How lines after the request line become headers or body: header name validation, skipped blank lines, { and [ body triggers.
en.keyboard-controls: Every key in the go-rest-client TUI: arrow navigation, Enter to send, Tab focus switching, Esc and Ctrl+C to quit.
en.response-display: How responses render in the info pane: status colors, headers, request duration, JSON pretty-printing, and the hint bar.
en.response-errors: What go-rest-client shows when a request cannot be built, fails to connect, times out, or fails while reading the body.
en.sse-streaming: Live Server-Sent Events display: text/event-stream detection, line-by-line rendering, 100-line cap, event count, 120s limit.
en.hot-reload: How go-rest-client watches the .http file with fsnotify, debounces saves by 200ms, and rebuilds the request list on reload.
en.architecture: One-diagram overview of go-rest-client: cmd/tui entry, internal/parser, internal/ui, fsnotify watcher, and net/http client.
en.cli-reference: gorc command syntax, the seven startup checks with their stderr messages, exit codes, and binary names per install method.
en.internal-packages: Exported types and functions of internal/ui and internal/parser: TUI, Request, NewTUI, UpdateLeftView, ReadFile, WatchFile.

zh.home: 邱敬幃（Pardn Chiu）開發的 Go 終端機 API client：讀取 .http 檔做 API 測試，存檔即時重載、SSE 串流逐行顯示。
zh.getting-started: 以 go build 或 go install 安裝 go-rest-client，用第一個 .http 檔送出請求，並了解它與其他 API 工具的差異。
zh.http-file-format: go-rest-client 如何切分 .http 檔：### 分隔線、### 名稱、請求行正規式與註解規則。
zh.http-file-format-headers-body: 請求行之後的每一行如何判定為 Header 或 Body：Header 名稱驗證、空行略過與 { [ 觸發規則。
zh.keyboard-controls: go-rest-client TUI 的所有按鍵：方向鍵瀏覽、Enter 送出、Tab 切換焦點、Esc 與 Ctrl+C 離開。
zh.response-display: 回應在資訊面板的呈現：狀態碼顏色、Header、請求耗時、JSON 自動縮排與提示列格式。
zh.response-errors: 請求無法建立、連線失敗、逾時或讀取 Body 失敗時，go-rest-client 顯示的內容。
zh.sse-streaming: SSE 即時顯示：text/event-stream 偵測、逐行渲染、100 行上限、事件數與 120 秒逾時。
zh.hot-reload: go-rest-client 以 fsnotify 監控 .http 檔、200ms 防抖後重新解析並重建請求清單的方式。
zh.cli-reference: gorc 命令語法、七項啟動檢查與對應 stderr 訊息、結束碼，以及各安裝方式的執行檔名稱。
zh.internal-packages: internal/ui 與 internal/parser 的匯出型別與函式：TUI、Request、NewTUI、ReadFile、WatchFile 等。
